title: Honours Thesis
description: The Honours thesis is based on research carried out by the student during the final year, under the supervision of a faculty member in the School of Languages, Linguistics and Cultures. The student will normally submit a thesis proposal early in the fall term, and a complete draft of the thesis by March 1. Regular meetings will take place between the student and the supervisor throughout the course.

items.text: minimum GPA of 6.0 in 300- and 400-level LING courses
